protocol.name: Litra HID++ protocol details
protocol.author: Community reverse-engineering of the Logitech HID++ Litra feature
protocol.comment: The HID++ feature layout used here (feature index 0x04, function nibbles for power, brightness and temperature) is publicly documented by community Litra implementations. Every command and response in this plugin was independently verified against a physical Litra Glow with probe_litra.py.
